title: Forty2 pairs core-banking transformation with full-BPM-lifecycle delivery
content:
Forty2 AG combines core-banking transformation with delivery across the full BPM lifecycle, which is an unusually precise pairing for this cohort. Most Flowable partner cards name either a vertical or a technology; this one names both, and the two reinforce each other — core-banking programmes are where modelled processes and approval chains carry regulatory weight.

Full-lifecycle BPM is the phrase that matters for the record-layer argument. A firm engaged from process design through to run has visibility of the point where the orchestration engine's own history stops being sufficient: the instance is a mutable row, its history can be purged, and nothing in the engine holds an append-only account of who decided what. A partner working only at implementation level never sees that gap as a client problem.

One data-quality caveat sits on the row: the Flowable card has no website link, so the domain was sourced externally and should be confirmed before any outreach. Onepoint's card in the same sweep has the same omission, which suggests the gap is in Flowable's directory data rather than in either firm. Provenance: Flowable Partner Finder, mined 2026-08-18, not imprint-swept.
